messages:
Sam (Product): Quick standup: we need final GA checklist items closed by EOD. SLA language, rollback steps, monitoring suppressions, pricing SKUs, and customer comms. Who takes what?
Iris (Eng): Eng will own rollback bullets + tiny SDK/curl snippets for quickstart. I'll paste them in 30m.
Maya (Legal): I'll review SLA reparations and exclusions. Prefer explicit transient exclusion (<5m) and a cap on credits.
Ken (Finance): I'll lock SKUs: hosted.generate.standard and hosted.generate.burst. Promo: PROMO-GA-2026 opt-in only. Need billing flag name.
Rory (SRE): Monitoring: propose tiered alerting for KV-cache misses (0-10m info, 10-60m warn, >60m page). Also want a post-deploy smoke at +15min.
Priya (Docs): Docs needs the rollback steps and the 429 error-handling snippet. Will merge after legal redlines and snippets.
CommsBot: Reminder: GA announcement draft due 24h before deploy. Owner: Sam.
Iris (Eng): Rollback draft:
1) Flip routing to fallback-model
2) Drain affected pool
3) Add reserved capacity or spin node
4) Invalidate KV cache if suspect
5) Run smoke and confirm P95/P99 within baseline
Iris (Eng): Curl snippet:
`curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H \"Authorization: Bearer $KEY\" -d '{"model":"rwd-v1","input":"Summarize..."}'`
Priya (Docs): Perfect. I'll include both and add billing dispute + promo opt-in steps to Billing FAQ.
Maya (Legal): Sending redlines on SLA in ~2h. I'll include opt-in consent text for soft-fallback.
Ken (Finance): Billing flag name: account.features.soft_fallback = true/false. I'll wire into billing once Legal confirms wording.
Rory (SRE): Scheduling smoke run for deploy +15m. Will post invite. We'll exercise paging and fallback routing.
Sam (Product): Owners recap: SLA/legal=Maya, Rollback+snippets=Iris, Monitoring=Rory, Pricing=Ken, Docs=Priya, Comms=Sam. Target: close all by EOD for deploy tomorrow. Post any blockers here. :white_check_mark:
